question: How must the stalk be bound together with the suṣumnā up to the navel interior?
premises: The stalk of the object is the item to be bound.
The binding extends up to the interior of the navel.
The stalk is to be bound together with the suṣumnā.
inference: The stalk must be fastened together with the suṣumnā so that the binding reaches the navel interior.
plain_english: Indeed, its stalk should be bound together with the suṣumnā up to the interior of the navel.
